Hi Bex

Mozilla Connect is the best place to share your feedback and ideas, and receive votes from the community. The Thunderbird team take these ideas into consideration when planning features and roadmaps.

The linked ideas below are similar to your own. You can show support by voting and commenting on them.

1. Thunderbird Android move controls to bottom

2. Extend Unified inbox with Unified spam, sent, draft, trash etc This feature is planned and currently in development. See here for more info.

You can customise the account color and set your own icon or image. Navigate to settings > account name > general settings

The sender color can also be customised, or use the image from your android contacts app. Navigate to settings > general settings > display

  • Colorise contacts
  • Contact name color
  • Show contact pictures
